description: X.509 certificate inspection from PEM — Takes a PEM-encoded X.509 certificate and returns its fields (subject, issuer, serial, validity window, SANs, key usage, EKU, basic constraints, signature algorithm, public key algorithm and bit size) plus a fail-on-issue audit: expired or not-yet-valid, hostname/SAN mismatch per RFC 6125 §6.4.3 wildcards, weak signature (SHA-1), short RSA (<2048), serverAuth without SAN (CABF BR 7.1.4.2.1). Decod

hostname.description: Optional hostname to check against the certificate's SANs.

intermediates.description: Intermediate certs (PEM) between leaf and anchor.

pem.description: A PEM block beginning with '-----BEGIN CERTIFICATE-----'.

trustAnchors.description: Trust anchors (PEM). When present, chain cryptographic verification runs.

name: x509-inspect
